newsitem.title: USA: Integrated Healthcare drops merger talks.
newsitem.headline: Integrated Healthcare drops merger talks.

text.p: Integrated Healthcare Systems Inc said Friday it has has suspended its discussions to be sold or merged with two unrelated companies. The acquisition discussions were announced on December 11.

Integrated said that it has decided, instead, to concentrate its efforts on marketing its DataQual line of products in insurance risk management applications. The company said on April 22 that it was pursuing business opportunities for its DataQual products in insurance risk management applications.
The company emphasized that it was not "closing the door completely" on its acquisition talks, but for now, it believes the important thing is to focus on its insurance applications.
Integrated develops, markets and maintains integrated quality and risk management software systems for the healthcare industry under the trade name of DataQual.
